sn45.140:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, yāni kānici jaṅgamānaṃ pāṇānaṃ padajātāni, sabbāni tāni hatthipade samodhānaṃ gacchanti.
sn45.140:1.3: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci kusalā dhammā, sabbe te appamādamūlakā, appamādasamosaraṇā. appamādo tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn45.140:1.4: appamattassetaṃ bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ: ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatīti
